rules.statement: The court has the power to add claimants as defendants before the trial stage of a partition action, provided their names are disclosed in the surveyor's report under Section 18(1) of the Partition Act. Once added, summonses must be issued.
rules.supporting_quote: "Clearly, the Judge was wrong when he ordered notice to be issued instead of summons. It is elementary that once a person becomes a party to an action as a defendant, he is entitled to be served with summons."
